text: Seow, raschke, elder-lens, wyckoff: a pull-in buy is the anticipation C5 forbids; my buy is the breakout. in_zone:ma_20 and a pullback test buy inside the reaction (D dist_to_20bar_high_pct 2.73, H1 pos_in_day_range_pct 39.5); trade_above:bar_high fires mid-base. Wyckoff: a close at the pivot is not a chase; C5's chase is a few % past it. Raschke I concede in part: a breakout on light volume fails, so day_vol must expand that day (C6). I act on ONE: close_above:high_52w_close, D. That close is also the turn up three of you wait for. Wrong if: daily close below ma_50.
